page_title: HAV 0-3 STR | Le Havre v Strasbourg 15/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Some great controlled play and passing from Le Havre. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90+1' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' 0 - 3 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Mamadou Sarr finds Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:3.
90' Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

89' What a great touch by Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
88' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
87' Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Le Havre.
84' Substitution. Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) walks off the pitch and Abdoul Ouattara comes on as a substitute.
84' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) replacing Abdoulaye Toure.
83' Substitution. Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) in, Steve Ngoura out.
82' Some patient build-up play from Strasbourg as they look to unlock the defence.
78' Abdelatif Kherradji shows a yellow card to Eduard Sobol (Strasbourg) for his blatant foul.

78' The cross into the penalty area from Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
78' Le Havre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Le Havre manage to earn a corner.
76' A pass from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is intercepted by Arthur Desmas and the move breaks down.
74' That's a well-taken pass by Sekou Mara (Strasbourg). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
72' Liam Rosenior decides to make a substitution. Emanuel Emegha will be replaced by Sekou Mara (Strasbourg).
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Sebastian Nanasi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Daouda Diongue (Strasbourg).
70' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
69' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) receives a pinpoint pass, takes one touch and produces a shot. It's a few inches shy of ending inside the left post. A great effort, though!
69' Strasbourg are ruled offside.

68' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
66' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
66' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) is replacing Rassoul Ndiaye.
64' Here is a change. Loic Nego is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Andre Ayew (Le Havre).
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Yanis Zouaoui will be replaced by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
64' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul after Loic Nego (Le Havre) hacks down one of his opponents. Free kick. Strasbourg will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
61' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
60' Here comes a substitution. Eduard Sobol (Strasbourg) is brought on as a substitute for Jeremy Sebas.
59' 56:44 – the latest ball possession ratio.
58' The game is interrupted now, Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
57' Loic Nego (Le Havre) pounces on a cross into the middle of the box, but plants his header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
55' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
55' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.

50' A precise low pass is received by Timothee Pembele (Le Havre), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
49' Handball by Steve Ngoura (Le Havre). Strasbourg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
47' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) makes a strong challenge and Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul. Strasbourg are awarded the free kick.
46' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) plays a through ball but overhits it.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+1' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
45+1' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. A free kick to Le Havre.
43' Surely that's handball by one of the Strasbourg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
42' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Strasbourg was in an offside position.
41' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
41' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick.
38' A player from Le Havre commits a rough challenge. Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

36' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
35' A spell of possession for Le Havre in an attempt to control the game.
32' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Dilane Bakwa tees up Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Arthur Desmas.
28' 0 - 1 Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) converts a killer cross before stroking a beautiful finish into the top right corner.
28' Strasbourg take a short corner kick.

27' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Arthur Desmas is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Strasbourg.
25' The ball has crossed the sideline. Strasbourg are taking a throw-in.
22' None of the Le Havre players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.

22' Loic Nego (Le Havre) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Le Havre.

21' A pass travels right across the box to Loic Nego (Le Havre) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic denies him with a decent save.
20' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
18' Le Havre hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
16' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) sends a long ball forward to Steve Ngoura, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
13' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
12' Some neat passing and movement from Strasbourg as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
11' Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. A free kick has been awarded to Le Havre.
9' The linesman signals a throw-in for Strasbourg.

6' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Arthur Desmas.
5' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
3' Strasbourg are seeing far more of the ball now.
1' The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick. Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Le Havre will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Abdelatif Kherradji.
